async function t25Travel(t){
 if(!town25dActive||t25TrafficLock||!t||!t.target||t25Distance(t)>2.65)return false;
 const gate=t.target==='mine'?SS_M16_PORTALS.townMine:SS_M16_PORTALS.village;
 t25TrafficLock=true;t25ClearInput();let result=false;

function t25Tick(dt,now){const should=ssRegion===T25_ID&&!farmWorldActive&&!archWorldActive&&!ssIsTitle();
 if(!should){if(town25dActive)t25Deactivate();if(ssRegion!==T25_ID)t25LastRegion=ssRegion;return false;}
 if(!town25dActive){t25Activate();if(t25LastRegion==='mine')town25dPlayer={x:-7.6,z:5.8};else if(t25LastRegion==='life_forest_01')town25dPlayer={x:8,z:5.4};if(game.town25dV1)game.town25dV1.position={...town25dPlayer};t25LastRegion='';}
 if(town25dEngine?.state==='ready'&&!paused)town25dEngine.start();else if(town25dEngine?.state==='paused'&&!paused)town25dEngine.resume();else if(town25dEngine?.state==='running'&&paused)town25dEngine.pause();
 if(now>t25ToastEnd)$('town25dToast').classList.remove('show');
 if(!paused){let sx=0,sy=0;const key=x=>t25Keys.has(x);if(key('w')||key('arrowup'))sy--;if(key('s')||key('arrowdown'))sy++;if(key('a')||key('arrowleft'))sx--;if(key('d')||key('arrowright'))sx++;

 const tx=(sx+sy)*.70710678*4.75,tz=(sy-sx)*.70710678*4.75;const damp=1-Math.exp(-dt*10);t25V.x+=(tx-t25V.x)*damp;t25V.z+=(tz-t25V.z)*damp;

 if(game?.town25dV1)game.town25dV1.position={...town25dPlayer};
 livingWorldTick(Math.max(0,dt));t25SavedTick+=dt;if(t25SavedTick>7){saveGame(true);t25SavedTick=0;}
 }
 t25RefreshHUD();return true;
}

 testSetCharges:n=>{if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0||n>mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax)return false;ropeLeapRemaining=n;ropeGroundStableSeconds=0;return true;},
 testSetRope:(anchor,targetY)=>{if(!anchor||!Number.isInteger(anchor.x)||!Number.isInteger(anchor.y)||!solid(tile(anchor.x,anchor.y)))return false;
 const tgt=Number.isFinite(targetY)&&targetY>=1&&targetY<p.y?targetY:p.y;
 rope={active:true,attached:tgt===p.y,anchor:{x:anchor.x,y:anchor.y,faceX:p.x,faceY:anchor.y+1},targetY:tgt};ropeAscentStartY=tgt<p.y?p.y:null;return true;},
 testSetDirection:dir=>{if(![-1,0,1].includes(dir))return false;input.left=dir<0;input.right=dir>0;return true;},
 testSetPlayer:(x,y)=>{if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<1||x>WW-2||y<1||y>WH-2)return false;
 releaseRope();p.x=x;p.y=y;p.vx=0;p.vy=0;p.grounded=false;ropeGroundStableSeconds=0;return true;}
};

window.__sandstarArtifacts={
 get:()=>({trait:game.character.trait,freeChangeUsed:game.character.traitFreeChangeUsed,level:deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp).level,slots:artifactSlotsFor(),coins:game.coins,system:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(game.artifactSystem)),effects:getEffectiveStats(),legacyRelics:game.relics}),
 trait:selectCharacterTrait,equip:equipArtifact,claim:tryAwardEarnedArtifacts,menu:(tab='artifacts')=>{characterTab=tab;characterMenu();},
 // Test helpers are not player-facing; they mutate only runtime debug state and never grant inventory directly.
 testProgress:(k,v)=>{if(!(k in game.artifactSystem.progress)||!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0)return false;game.artifactSystem.progress[k]=v;return true;}
};
window.__sandstarVision={
  state:()=>({radius:effectiveSightRadius(),depth:visionDepth(),fade:visionFade(),visibleCells:visionCache.visible.size,exploredCells:visionExploredBits.reduce((n,b)=>n+b.toString(2).replace(/0/g,'').length,0),saveKey:SAVE_KEY,legacyRelics:game.relics}),
  visible:(x,y)=>visionVisible(x,y),explored:(x,y)=>isExplored(x,y),solidMemory:(x,y)=>bitRead(visionSolidBits,x,y),
  reveal:()=>{updateVisionCache(true);return true;},
  snapshot:()=>{prepareVisionForSave();return {...game.vision};},
  invalidate:()=>{visionCache.cx=-999;},
  setPlayer:(x,y)=>{if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<1||x>WW-2||y<1||y>WH-2)return false;releaseRope();p.x=x;p.y=y;p.vx=p.vy=0;visionCache.cx=-999;updateVisionCache();return true;}
};

window.__sandstarCavernP12={source:(ax,ay)=>ssCavernSourceV4(ax,ay),at:(x,y)=>ssCavernFeatureV4(x,y),clue:(x,y)=>ssCavernClueAt(x,y),journal:()=>[...(game.cavernDiscoveries||[])],tick:()=>ssCavernCheckDiscovery(),feetOffset:()=>PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET,tilesForVersion:(version,coords)=>{const was=game.worldGenVersion;try{game.worldGenVersion=version;return coords.map(([x,y])=>tile(x,y));}finally{game.worldGenVersion=was;}},featureForVersion:(version,x,y)=>{const was=game.worldGenVersion;try{game.worldGenVersion=version;return ssCavernFeatureV4(x,y);}finally{game.worldGenVersion=was;}}};
window.__sandstarRopeHangP11={snapshot:()=>({active:rope.active,vertical:rope.mode!=='swing'&&rope.mode!=='pull',paused:ropeHangPaused,autoChain:ropeAutoChain,targetY:rope.targetY,startY:ropeAscentStartY,playerY:p.y,playerX:p.x,attached:rope.attached,reelIn:input.reelIn,reelOut:input.reelOut,ropeAnchor:rope.anchor?{x:rope.anchor.x,y:rope.anchor.y}:null}),toggle:()=>toggleRope()};
window.__sandstarRopeUX={snapshot:()=>({gesture:ropePointerAim?.gesture||null,direction:ropePointerAim?.direction||null,preview:ropePreviewAnchor?{...ropePreviewAnchor}:null,hint:$('ropeHint').textContent,slop:ROPE_TOUCH_SLOP,hapticsEnabled:ropeHapticsEnabled,pending:ropeReelPending}),direction:(dx,dy,previous='up')=>ropeDirectionFromDrag(dx,dy,previous)};
window.__sandstarDebug={economy:()=>({reserveLiftMaterials:game.economy.reserveLiftMaterials,reserveForgeMaterials:game.economy.reserveForgeMaterials,pending:liftNeedsRepair(),available:Object.fromEntries(ORE_SALE_ITEMS.map(([id])=>[id,sellableOreCount(id)])),liftReservation:Object.fromEntries(ORE_SALE_ITEMS.map(([id])=>[id,liftReservedOreCount(id)])),forgeReservation:Object.fromEntries(ORE_SALE_ITEMS.map(([id])=>[id,nextForgeReserveOreCount(id)])),sold:game.economy.totalOreSold,earned:game.economy.totalCreditsEarned,metrics:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(balanceStats())),next:forgeRule()?.items||[]}),liftArt:()=>({ready:liftDoorSprites.ready,failed:liftDoorSprites.failed,width:LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH,height:LIFT_SPRITE_HEIGHT,open:liftDoorSprites.open.naturalWidth,locked:liftDoorSprites.locked.naturalWidth}),feedback:()=>miningFeedbackState(),tap:(x,y)=>tileAction(x,y,true),sprite:()=>({sizePixels:PLAYER_DRAW_SIZE,collisionHeightTiles:PLAYER_HEIGHT,reachTiles:effectiveMineReach(),ready:minerSpriteReady,toolsReady:minerToolsReady,animation:animName,frame:currentMinerFrame(),mining:isMiningAnimationActive(),direction:currentMiningDirection(),visualFacing:minerVisualFacing(),tool:game.tool,canvasSize:[cv.width,cv.height]}),get:()=>({x:p.x,y:p.y,seed:game.seed,mined:game.mined,coins:game.coins,inv:game.inv,edits:Object.keys(game.edits).length,pickaxeLevel:game.pickaxeLevel||1,tool:game.tool,oreFinds:game.oreFinds,relics:game.relics,worldGenVersion:game.worldGenVersion,forge:{...game.pickaxeForge},saveOkay}),teleport:(x,y)=>{releaseRope();ropeChainRemaining=p16RopeChainCap();ropeGroundStableSeconds=0;ropeGrabCooldown=0;ropeSnap=null;p.x=x;p.y=y;p.vy=0;p.vx=0;jumpBuffer=0;coyoteTime=0;airLeapControl=false},mine:(x,y)=>{doMine(x,y,999);updHud()},canReach:(x,y)=>canReach(x,y),collides:(x,y)=>collides(x,y),tile:(x,y)=>tile(x,y),setTool:(tool)=>{if(TOOL_INFO[tool]){game.unlockedTools.push(tool);game.tool=tool;updHud()}},setCoins:(n)=>{game.coins=n;updHud()},resources:()=>({layerVersion:game.resourceLayerVersion,stock:{titanium:game.inv.titanium||0,starshard:game.inv.starshard||0},prices:ORE_SALE_ITEMS.filter(a=>a[0]==='titanium'||a[0]==='starshard').map(a=>({id:a[0],price:a[2]})),assets:window.__sandstarDuriOreArt.mapping()}),getProgress:()=>({key:holdLast,progress:holdProgress}),getStick:()=>({active:stickActive,dir:stickDir}),mobility:()=>({rope:{...rope},ropeJumpUsed:remainingRopeLeaps()===0,ropeLeapRemaining:remainingRopeLeaps(),ropeLeapMax:mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax,ropeGroundStableSeconds,ropeGrabCooldown,ropeSnap:!!ropeSnap,vy:p.vy,vx:p.vx,grounded:p.grounded,jumpBuffer,coyoteTime,airLeapControl,ropeAim,ropeHold,ropeHoldTime,pointerDirection:ropePointerAim?.direction||null,candidate:ropeCandidate,transport:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(game.transport)),nearby:nearbyStation?.id||null}),rope:()=>toggleRope(),fireRopeAim:dir=>fireDirectionalRope(dir),startSwing:dir=>startRopeSwing(dir),reel:delta=>adjustRopeLength(delta),transfer:dir=>transferRope(dir),chain:()=>({remaining:ropeChainRemaining,window:ropeChainWindow,limit:ROPE_CHAIN_MAX}),findAimAnchor:dir=>findDirectionalRopeAnchor(dir),findAnchor:()=>findRopeAnchor(),nearStation:()=>closestStation()?.id||null,stationMenu:()=>stationMenu(),travel:(id)=>travelStation(id),rescue:()=>rescuePlayer(),grantRepair:()=>{game.inv.stone+=STATION_COST.stone;game.inv.copper+=STATION_COST.copper;game.coins+=STATION_COST.coins;},aim:(dx,dy)=>setStickDirection(dx,dy),releaseAim:()=>stopMineStick(),holdMine:(dt)=>mineHold(dt),save:()=>saveGame(true)};
})();
</script>
